# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b18 - Room Environment limits and room feedback precedence

This opt-in beta moves environmental operating limits to the place where they conceptually belong: the room. The Home → Room Environment → managed physical-device hierarchy remains unchanged. Stable **v0.5.1** remains Latest.

## One limit set per room

Temperature, humidity and percentage-fan min/max limits are no longer duplicated on every managed physical-device controller. They are configuration Number entities on the **Room Environment** device.

A room exposes only the limit categories supported by its selected physical equipment:
- temperature min/max when at least one selected managed device can control temperature;
- humidity min/max when at least one selected managed device can control humidity;
- fan percentage min/max when at least one selected managed device exposes percentage fan control.

The editable range itself comes from the common safe intersection of the currently available compatible devices. For example, if one thermostat supports 5–35 °C and another supports 16–30 °C, the room temperature limits can be configured only within 16–30 °C. At runtime each controller also re-applies its own native limits, so a device with stricter capabilities cannot be pushed outside them.

These limits constrain **Home Environment Manager-owned commands**. They do not seize manual/native control from another integration and cannot physically guarantee environmental temperature or humidity against external heat loads, open windows or offline equipment.

## Upgrade from beta17

Beta17 briefly stored these limits per controller. Beta18 keeps those saved values for migration:
- room minimum defaults use the highest valid saved per-device minimum;
- room maximum defaults use the lowest valid saved per-device maximum;
- an impossible/conflicting old set falls back to the room's common native range.

The old beta17 per-device limit entity-registry entries are explicitly removed on the Number platform so they do not remain as unavailable controls on managed physical devices. Other controller entities, IDs and saved settings are not removed.

## Room measurements are the controller feedback source

When the rooms-first setup contains explicit room source selections, every managed controller in that room uses those **room sources** for feedback rather than preferring measurements exposed by the climate device itself.

For temperature and humidity, all selected valid room sensors are averaged. For CO₂ and PM2.5, only the selected room air-quality sources matching the requested metric participate. If an explicitly selected source is unavailable or stale, feedback is unavailable instead of silently substituting the thermostat's built-in sensor.

This means the Managed Climate facade's current temperature/humidity, PID feedback and automatic-control decisions reflect the sensors selected for the room. A thermostat's own current-temperature/current-humidity attributes remain native-device data, but they do not override explicit room measurement selection. Legacy installations without explicit room-source configuration retain the previous compatibility fallback.

## Per-device controls remain per device

The beta17 controls that are genuinely equipment-specific remain on each managed physical-device controller:
- Quiet when in room;
- Quiet when sleeping;
- quiet fan percentage/native quiet mode;
- Always / Room occupied / Room absent control availability;
- control method, power permission, PID algorithm settings and hardware runtime/dwell settings.

Physical availability is still checked before control calculations, and command ownership, acknowledgements, manual/restart holds, window/defrost interlocks and minimum ON/OFF protections remain in force.

## Validation and install

Publication is gated by the full Python 3.13/3.14 regression suite, deterministic 38-language/controller-help generation, frontend tests, Hassfest, HACS and installed Home Assistant 2026.10 registry/setup checks. These tests do not operate the user's live Home Assistant installation or certify physical HVAC equipment.

Install with beta versions enabled in HACS, select **v0.6.0b18**, restart Home Assistant and keep the existing integration entry. Open each Room Environment device to review the migrated room-wide limits. Managed physical-device controllers retain their quiet/occupancy/control-method settings.
